@deskActNotUpdated.description: Title of the toast on Activity when the refresh could not ask the node; the reason follows as its text.

@deskActSearchHint.description: Placeholder of the search field on Activity. Narrow field.

@deskActSearchHintEmpty.description: Placeholder of the search field on Activity when there are no transactions yet. Narrow field.

@deskActSearchLabel.description: Screen reader label of the search field on Activity.

@deskActClearSearch.description: Tooltip of the button that empties the search field; also the button of the 'no match' state.

@deskActShowAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Activity that shows the hidden amounts.

@deskActHideAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Activity that hides amounts.

@deskActRefresh.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Activity that asks the node for new transactions.

@deskActTitle.description: Title of the Activity page: the list of all transactions.

@deskActDetailReceived.description: Title of the transaction detail for an incoming payment, in the pane beside the list or on its own page.

@deskActDetailSent.description: Title of the transaction detail for an outgoing payment, in the pane beside the list or on its own page.

@deskActLoading.description: Line with a spinner on Activity while the transactions are being read.

deskActWaitingNode: Waiting for the node to be synced.

@deskActWaitingNode.description: Line with a spinner on Activity while the node has not finished syncing, so there is no list yet.

@deskActFilterAll.description: Filter tab on Activity: every transaction. Narrow tab; a count follows it.

@deskActFilterReceived.description: Filter tab on Activity: incoming payments. Narrow tab; a count follows it.

@deskActFilterSent.description: Filter tab on Activity: outgoing payments. Narrow tab; a count follows it.

@deskActNoMatchTitle.description: Title of the empty state on Activity when the search and filter show nothing.

deskActNoMatchText: Try another address or slate id, or clear the filter.

@deskActNoMatchText.description: Text of the empty state on Activity when the search and filter show nothing.

@deskActPageOf.description: Pager caption under the Activity list: the current page of all pages.

@deskActPrevPage.description: Tooltip of the pager's previous button.

@deskActNextPage.description: Tooltip of the pager's next button.

@deskActPages.description: Screen reader label of the pager group.

@deskActColFromTo.description: Column header of the Activity table: who the other side is. Narrow header.

@deskActColStatus.description: Column header of the Activity table. Narrow header.

@deskActColTime.description: Column header of the Activity table: the clock time. Narrow header, right aligned.

@deskActColAmount.description: Column header of the Activity table. Narrow header, right aligned.

@deskActEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state on Activity when the wallet has no transactions.

deskActEmptyText: Every payment sent or received is listed here, newest first, with who it was with and how far along it is.

@deskActEmptyText.description: Text of the empty state on Activity when the wallet has no transactions.

@deskActStageWaiting.description: Title of the first of three stages a payment goes through, in the empty state of Activity.

deskActStageWaitingText: Both wallets sign it. Over Epicbox this is automatic.

@deskActStageWaitingText.description: Text of the first stage in the empty state of Activity.

@deskActStageConfirming.description: Title of the second stage in the empty state of Activity.

deskActStageConfirmingText: On the chain. About one block a minute.

@deskActStageConfirmingText.description: Text of the second stage in the empty state of Activity.

@deskActStageSpendable.description: Title of the third stage in the empty state of Activity.

deskActStageSpendableText: {needed, plural, one{After {needed} confirmation, about {needed} minute.} other{After {needed} confirmations, about {needed} minutes.}}

@deskActStageSpendableText.description: Text of the third stage in the empty state of Activity: the number of confirmations before the money can be spent; the minutes equal the confirmations (one block a minute).

@deskActShowAddress.description: Primary button in the empty state of Activity: opens the Receive page.

@deskActReceiveFile.description: Ghost button in the empty state of Activity: opens the page to import a payment file.
